SM80 GDN source attribution and license

The chunked prefill implementation, where included, adapts src/prefill/gdn_tc.cuh
and the cp.async helpers from src/prefill/kernels.cu at:
https://github.com/Niko1221/Strata/tree/51567de1a676df36461eb48b46551aab13d8fa9e

The tensor products and chunk recurrence retain that source. The adaptation uses
Avalon's strided normalized tensors, context-owned scratch, state transposes and
existing replay/gather/cache handling.

The key-head decode implementation, where included, is native Avalon code using
Avalon's state layout and recurrence arithmetic. Its grouping of value heads
sharing a key head was inspired by the gdn_rec_kh_kernel schedule in the same
source. It is not a verbatim import of that decode kernel. Replay stash and commit
handling follow Avalon's gdn-body.cuh contract.

Retain this notice with distributions containing either adaptation.
